process_area.title: Sourcing Agent, Overseas Buying Office & Import Vendor Management

value_stream.name: Global Sourcing, Import Buying & Sourcing Agent Management

fields.Participants: Global Sourcing, Procurement (links to VS-03/VS-34), Legal (links to VS-100.3), Finance (links to VS-17.4), ABC (links to VS-86.3), Quality (links to VS-31), Data Privacy (links to VS-91), Compliance (links to VS-22)

workflows.name: Sourcing Agent Selection, Contracting & Performance Management

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-count of "country-coverage assessment, references, commercial model" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-log of "Global Sourcing/Legal contract the agent" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-review of "review, fee reconciliation, and corrective action / replacement when…" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-596 (ensure controlled execution — Sourcing Agent, Overseas Buying Office & Import Vendor Management (PA-122.2).)
- operational: audit rights and direct vendor visibility (links to W3795/W3796); operational: ABC terms and due diligence (links to VS-86)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Agent-capture risk**: Agent controls vendor/price visibility; mitigated by audit rights and direct vendor visibility (links to W3795/W3796)
- **ABC risk**: Agent pays/kicks back to BuildRight staff or vendors; mitigated by ABC terms and due diligence (links to VS-86.3)
System Touchpoints: - Procurement (links to VS-03/VS-34); legal/contracts (links to VS-100.3/W688); ABC (links to VS-86.3); data privacy (links to VS-91); quality (links to VS-31); finance (links to VS-17.4)

steps.activity: Global Sourcing/Procurement source and select sourcing agents: RFP, capability/country-coverage assessment, references, commercial model (commission, mark-up, fee), financial/compliance due diligence (links to VS-86.3), and shortlist/recommend per the sourcing-model decision (W3787)

Global Sourcing/Legal contract the agent: scope of authority (sourcing, vendor management, consolidation, QC, logistics), commission/fee, exclusivity/territory, IP and BuildRight-owned specifications (links to VS-100.2), anti-bribery (links to VS-86.3), data protection (links to VS-91), audit rights, termination, and KPIs

Global Sourcing manage agent performance: KPI scorecard (savings, quality, on-time, vendor-base management, compliance), periodic business review, fee reconciliation, and corrective action / replacement when underperforming

fields.Participants: Global Sourcing, Legal (links to VS-100.3), HR (links to VS-19/VS-103), Finance (links to VS-17.4/VS-18/VS-72), Tax (links to VS-79), Compliance (links to VS-22/VS-86), IT (links to VS-27)
fields.Volume: Overseas buying office/representative (where office model chosen)

workflows.name: Overseas Buying Office Strategy, Establishment & Operations

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-count of "country selection, legal-entity/representative-office structure" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-report of "reporting to HQ, systems/IT" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-measure of "measure overseas-office ROI" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-596 (ensure controlled execution — Sourcing Agent, Overseas Buying Office & Import Vendor Management (PA-122.2).)
- operational: ROI threshold and model review (links to W3787); operational: governance and reporting
Pain Points / Risks: - **Overhead risk**: Office overhead exceeds savings at lower volumes; mitigated by ROI threshold and model review (links to W3787)
- **Governance-distance risk**: Remote office drifts from HQ control; mitigated by governance and reporting
System Touchpoints: - Legal/entity (links to VS-100.3/VS-36); HR (links to VS-19/VS-103); tax/TP (links to VS-79/VS-72); treasury (links to VS-18); IT (links to VS-27); finance (links to VS-17.4)

steps.activity: Global Sourcing/Legal/Finance establish the overseas buying office (where the office model is chosen): country selection, legal-entity/representative-office structure (links to VS-100.3/VS-36), tax/transfer-pricing (links to VS-79/VS-72), staffing model (expat/local — links to VS-19/VS-103), and budget

Global Sourcing/HR operate the overseas office: staff hiring/management (links to VS-19/VS-103), governance and reporting to HQ, systems/IT (links to VS-27), and integration to BuildRight's global-sourcing and merchandising processes

Global Sourcing/Finance measure overseas-office ROI (savings, vendor-base value, control improvement, overhead) vs the agent/direct alternatives (links to W3808) and recommend continuation/expansion/consolidation

fields.Participants: Global Sourcing, Vendor Mgmt (links to VS-03), Quality (links to VS-31), Customs (links to VS-87), AML (links to VS-86), Legal (links to VS-100.3), Finance (links to VS-17.4), Master Data (links to VS-29)

workflows.name: Import Vendor Onboarding, Qualification & Master Governance

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-count of "Global Sourcing/Vendor-Mgmt onboard and qualify import vendors" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-record of "Global Sourcing/Master-Data establish and maintain the import vendor master" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-import of "Global Sourcing/Compliance maintain vendor re-qualification" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - operational: qualification gate; operational: master governance
Pain Points / Risks: - **Under-qualified-vendor risk**: Import vendor onboarded without proper diligence; mitigated by qualification gate
- **Master-data-error risk**: Bad vendor/lead-time/Incoterms data corrupts planning; mitigated by master governance
System Touchpoints: - Vendor master (links to VS-29/W402); quality audit (links to VS-31); customs (links to VS-87); AML (links to VS-86); vendor portal (links to VS-03.4); legal (links to VS-100.3)

steps.activity: Global Sourcing/Vendor-Mgmt onboard and qualify import vendors: legal/financial due diligence, sanctions/restricted-party screening (links to VS-86), trade-compliance and country-of-origin validation (links to VS-87), factory capability audit (links to VS-31/W160/W1546), and capacity/lead-time/MOQ capture — extending the onboarding discipline of VS-03.1 with import-specific qualification

Global Sourcing/Master-Data establish and maintain the import vendor master record (links to VS-29/W402): country, Incoterms, currency, payment terms, lead time, certifications (links to VS-117), agent/office linkage, and compliance status; integrate to ERP/vendor portal (links to VS-03.4)
Global Sourcing/Compliance maintain vendor re-qualification (periodic financial/compliance/factory re-audit links to W1546) and manage offboarding/replacement of import vendors

fields.Participants: Global Sourcing, Buyers (links to VS-01/VS-19), Finance (links to VS-17.4/VS-106), Logistics Finance (links to W3788), Legal (links to VS-100.3), Merchandising (links to VS-01)
fields.Trigger: Sourcing cycle; cost-reduction target; contract renewal

workflows.name: Import Vendor Negotiation, FOB Pricing & Cost-Reduction Management

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-import of "import vendor negotiation" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-document of "document pricing in contracts/schedules" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-track of "track realized FOB savings vs target" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-596 (ensure controlled execution — Sourcing Agent, Overseas Buying Office & Import Vendor Management (PA-122.2).)
- operational: realized-savings tracking; operational: index-based pricing (links to VS-106)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Negotiation-leakage risk**: Savings negotiated but not realized in margin; mitigated by realized-savings tracking
- **Price-volatility risk**: Fixed price on volatile commodity; mitigated by index-based pricing (links to VS-106)
System Touchpoints: - Commodity (links to VS-106); finance/costing (links to VS-17.4); legal (links to VS-100.3); rebate (links to VS-39); merchandise finance (links to VS-101)

steps.activity: Global Sourcing/Buyers run import vendor negotiation: market price benchmarking (FOB commodity indices links to VS-106), should-cost modeling, volume leverage and consolidated-buy negotiation across categories/entities, and Incoterms/payment-terms optimization (links to W3788)
Global Sourcing/Legal document pricing in contracts/schedules (links to W688/VS-100.3): price-adjustment mechanism (raw-material index, FX clause), volume tiers, and rebate/incentive (links to VS-39)

Global Sourcing/Finance track realized FOB savings vs target (cost-reduction program), publish savings analytics (links to W3808), and ensure savings flow to margin/retail (links to VS-101) not just negotiated

fields.Participants: Global Sourcing, Merchandising (links to VS-01), Quality (links to VS-31), Supply Planning (links to VS-02), Vendor Scorecard (links to VS-67), Compliance (links to VS-22)
fields.Volume: Strategic import vendor portfolio (top ~20 = ~45% of import COGS)

workflows.name: Import Vendor Development, Capacity & Relationship Management

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-import of "Global Sourcing develop strategic import vendors" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-forecast of "forecast sharing, production/slot reservation, peak-season capacity, and…" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-review of "Global Sourcing/Vendor-Scorecard run import-vendor performance review" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-596 (ensure controlled execution — Sourcing Agent, Overseas Buying Office & Import Vendor Management (PA-122.2).)
- operational: capacity reservation; operational: JBP and development
Pain Points / Risks: - **Capacity-loss risk**: Strategic vendor cannot meet peak demand; mitigated by capacity reservation
- **Relationship-neglect risk**: Strategic vendors under-developed; mitigated by JBP and development
System Touchpoints: - Vendor scorecard (links to VS-67); private label (links to VS-41); supply planning (links to VS-02.2); quality (links to VS-31); merchandising (links to VS-01)

steps.activity: Global Sourcing develop strategic import vendors: joint business planning, capacity/reservation agreements for critical SKUs, co-development (links to VS-41 private label), and long-term partnership — extending VS-67.3 vendor development to the import-sourcing context

Global Sourcing/Supply-Planning manage import vendor capacity and allocation: forecast sharing, production/slot reservation, peak-season capacity, and capacity escalation — feeding import PO planning (links to VS-02.2)

Global Sourcing/Vendor-Scorecard run import-vendor performance review (delivery, quality, cost, compliance, lead time, responsiveness), integrate into VS-67 scorecard, and drive development/corrective action

fields.Participants: Global Sourcing, Quality (links to VS-31), Private Label (links to VS-41), Compliance (links to VS-22/VS-25), ESG (links to VS-25.2), ABC (links to VS-86.3), Agent/Office (links to W3793/W3794)

workflows.name: Source-Side Quality, Social-Compliance & Factory Audit Program

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-inspect of "Global Sourcing/Quality plan and execute source-side audits" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-track of "tracking, verification, escalation, and vendor risk-rating that feeds sourcing…" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-import of "Global Sourcing/ESG integrate source-side social/environmental compliance into BuildRight's responsible-sourcing" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - operational: pre-shipment inspection; operational: social audit (links to W1546)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Source-quality risk**: Defective import goods reach DCs; mitigated by pre-shipment inspection
- **Social-compliance risk**: Import vendor labor/environment violations; mitigated by social audit (links to W1546)
System Touchpoints: - Quality (links to VS-31); private label (links to VS-41); ESG (links to VS-25.2); ABC (links to VS-86.3); certification (links to VS-117); audit CAPA

steps.activity: Global Sourcing/Quality plan and execute source-side audits: pre-shipment inspection (links to W1613), factory quality audit (links to W1838), and social-compliance/ethical audit (labor, health/safety, environment — links to W1845/W1546/W353), via BuildRight staff, the overseas office (W3794), agents (W3793), or accredited third parties

Global Sourcing/Quality manage audit findings and corrective action (CAPA) with import vendors: issue tracking, verification, escalation, and vendor risk-rating that feeds sourcing decisions and scorecards (links to VS-67)

Global Sourcing/ESG integrate source-side social/environmental compliance into BuildRight's responsible-sourcing and ESG reporting (links to VS-25.2/W195/W1176), and ensure DTI-BPS/certification compliance for regulated imports (links to VS-117)

fields.Participants: Global Sourcing, IT (links to VS-27/VS-113), Enterprise Architecture (links to VS-113), Vendor Portal (links to VS-03.4), Master Data (links to VS-29), Data Privacy (links to VS-91)

workflows.name: Import Vendor Portal, EDI & B2B Integration at Source

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-capture of "enterprise integration architecture" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-document of "document submission, master-data accuracy" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-monitor of "monitor integration health and vendor adoption" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-596 (ensure controlled execution — Sourcing Agent, Overseas Buying Office & Import Vendor Management (PA-122.2).)
- operational: portal/EDI adoption; operational: RA 10173 governance (links to VS-91)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Manual-exchange risk**: Import PO/ASN handled by email → errors/delays; mitigated by portal/EDI adoption
- **Cross-border-data risk**: Vendor data mishandled across borders; mitigated by RA 10173 governance (links to VS-91)
System Touchpoints: - Vendor portal (links to VS-03.4); EDI/integration (links to VS-110/VS-15/VS-113); master data (links to VS-29); data privacy (links to VS-91); IT ops (links to VS-27.1)

steps.activity: Global Sourcing/IT/EA enable B2B integration with import vendors/agents: vendor portal access (PO, ASN, invoice links to VS-03.4), EDI for high-volume vendors (850/856/810 — links to VS-110/VS-15), document/certificate exchange (links to VS-117), aligned to enterprise integration architecture (links to VS-113/W257/W3579)
Global Sourcing/Vendor-Mgmt drive vendor adoption and data quality: ASN/compliance-document submission, master-data accuracy (links to VS-29), and secure cross-border data handling (links to VS-91)
steps.r: Global Sourcing / Master Data / Vendor Mgmt

steps.activity: Global Sourcing/IT monitor integration health and vendor adoption (links to VS-27.1/W595), publish integration-coverage analytics, and prioritize the next integrations by volume/value

fields.Participants: Global Sourcing, Compliance (links to VS-22), ABC (links to VS-86.3), Audit (links to VS-21), Legal (links to VS-100.3), Finance (links to VS-17.4), Speak-Up (links to VS-119)
fields.Trigger: Risk cycle (links to VS-21.2); ABC event; COI disclosure

workflows.name: Overseas-Office & Agent Risk, Anti-Bribery & Conflict-of-Interest Governance

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-capture of "entertainment and facilitation-payment controls, COI disclosure for sourcing…" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-validate of "verify agent invoices/commissions for irregularity" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-post of "posture to audit/governance" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-596 (ensure controlled execution — Sourcing Agent, Overseas Buying Office & Import Vendor Management (PA-122.2).)
- operational: due diligence and controls (links to VS-86); operational: COI disclosure
Pain Points / Risks: - **ABC-violation risk**: Bribery via overseas agent/office; mitigated by due diligence and controls (links to VS-86.3)
- **COI risk**: Sourcing staff tied to vendors; mitigated by COI disclosure
System Touchpoints: - ABC (links to VS-86.3); audit (links to VS-21); legal (links to VS-100.3); speak-up (links to VS-119); compliance (links to VS-22); governance (links to VS-36)

steps.activity: Global Sourcing/ABC manage anti-bribery and conflict-of-interest risk in overseas sourcing: agent/staff due diligence (links to W3793/W3794), gifts/entertainment and facilitation-payment controls, COI disclosure for sourcing staff, and third-party-intermediary screening (links to VS-86.3)
Global Sourcing/Audit run import-sourcing controls testing and overseas-office/agent audits (links to VS-21.3/W353), manage findings, and verify agent invoices/commissions for irregularity

Global Sourcing/Speak-Up ensure overseas sourcing channels have access to the speak-up channel (links to VS-119), investigate allegations, and report ABC/sourcing-integrity posture to audit/governance (links to VS-36)
